ai_briefing.morning_summary: Bitcoin and Ethereum slipped modestly while BNB, XRP and Dogecoin posted small gains, leaving the market largely flat. Liquidity has rebounded after the October flash‑crash but altcoins remain vulnerable and volatility, though lower overall, is showing more frequent spikes. New token listings on Delta India add modest upside potential.
